fact: Car 55 overtook Car 77 during the formation lap.
offence: Breach of Article B5.6.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 55 was mandated to start the Sprint from the pit lane because of another breach and therefore the driver entered the pit lane at the end of the formation lap. By doing so, he overtook Car 77 shortly before reaching Safety Car Line 1 and this is considered a breach of Article B5.6.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. As the mandated consequence for such an infringement (pit lane start) is redundant in this case, the Stewards issue a Warning to the driver in line with previous decisions.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Starting Procedure Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
